BiblicalUsage: Mutsaq is narrowness, distress — nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, and God would have removed Job out of the strait into a broad place, and by the breath of God frost is given, and the breadth of the waters is straitened.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the narrow place is where God does His best work: the strait is not the end, it is the passage into the broad place.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
